description: Build .NET iOS apps (net*-ios, Native AOT) on Linux, Windows and macOS without Xcode. An MSBuild SDK that replaces the Xcode tools the iOS workload calls (xcrun, clang through zig, codesign, ibtool, actool, ditto, ...) with open-source C# implementations, and links against stubs made without the Apple SDK. For local development builds, not App Store distribution.
